name: Webshop Settings-payment_method_rules
label: Payment Method Rules
description: Per customer-type payment method. A row with no Payment Gateway Account means that customer type uses the manual bank-transfer flow instead of a gateway. Add/edit rows here to change payment methods without any code changes.

name: Quotation-customer_type
label: Customer Type
description: Set in code (highskills_erpnext.overrides.cart.custom_place_order) when the Quotation is submitted - not via fetch_from, since party_name is a Dynamic Link (Customer or Lead) that fetch_from can't reliably resolve. Lets a Notification record condition on Individual vs Company (e.g. "doc.customer_type == 'Company'") without any code - Notification conditions can only do plain attribute access on doc, confirmed no frappe.db access is exposed there (notification.py's own get_context() only exposes frappe.utils).

name: Quotation-po_uploaded
label: Purchase Order Uploaded
description: Set automatically when a Company (bank-transfer) customer uploads their Purchase Order document at /bank-transfer, or manually by staff if the customer sent it by email instead. Editable post-submit (allow_on_submit) since the Quotation is already submitted by the time this is relevant. Used by staff to find Quotations awaiting manual conversion to Sales Order.

name: Quotation-payment_proof_uploaded
label: Payment Proof Uploaded
description: Set automatically when a Company (bank-transfer) customer uploads a proof-of-payment document at /bank-transfer, or manually by staff if the customer sent it by email instead. Editable post-submit (allow_on_submit) since the Quotation is already submitted by the time this is relevant. Lives on Quotation (not Sales Order) because the customer can upload proof before staff have manually converted the Quotation to a Sales Order. Used by Accounts to filter orders awaiting manual bank-transfer reconciliation.

name: Item-term_months
label: Subscription Term (Months)
description: For SaaS/subscription items only: number of months the one-time price covers. Used to show a monthly-equivalent price breakdown on quotations/orders and to size the entitlement window when payment is confirmed.

name: Sales Order-entitlement_start_date
label: Entitlement Start Date
description: Set automatically once payment for this order is confirmed (Payment Entry submitted) - never at order placement. Product access should only be granted from this date.

name: Sales Order-entitlement_end_date
label: Entitlement End Date
description: Entitlement Start Date + the purchased item's Subscription Term (Months). Product access should be disallowed after this date.

name: Sales Invoice-entitlement_start_date
label: Entitlement Start Date
description: Set automatically once payment for this invoice is confirmed (Payment Entry submitted) - never at invoice creation. Product access should only be granted from this date.

name: Sales Invoice-entitlement_end_date
label: Entitlement End Date
description: Entitlement Start Date + the purchased item's Subscription Term (Months). Product access should be disallowed after this date.

name: Quotation Item-term_price_breakdown
label: Term Price Breakdown
description: Auto-populated for subscription items (Item.term_months set): "<monthly rate>/month x <N> months = <total>". Set by highskills_erpnext.subscription_pricing.apply_subscription_term_pricing, shown on the cart page and on the Quotation print format.

name: Sales Order Item-term_price_breakdown
label: Term Price Breakdown
description: Auto-populated for subscription items (Item.term_months set): "<monthly rate>/month x <N> months = <total>". Set by highskills_erpnext.subscription_pricing.apply_subscription_term_pricing, shown on the Sales Order print format.
